pool.text: In a survey of students in Year 11 Group #1, \(|A| = 18\) study French, \(|B| = 15\) study Spanish, \(|A \cap B| = 5\) study both languages, and \(4\) study neither. Find the total number of students \(|\mathcal{E}|\).
pool.sol: By inclusion-exclusion, \(|A \cup B| = 18 + 15 - 5 = 28\). Adding the \(4\) outside \(A \cup B\) gives \(|\mathcal{E}| = 32\).
hints: Compute \(|A \cup B| = |A| + |B| - |A \cap B|\) so the overlap \(5\) is not double-counted.
Add the \(4\) students who belong to \((A \cup B)'\).
Combine \(28 + 4\) to obtain \(|\mathcal{E}|\).

pool.text: By completing the square for \(y = x^2 - 4x - 1\) (Case #1), find the coordinates of the turning point of the curve.

hints: Factor \(1\) out of the \(x^2\) and \(x\) terms first.

Read off the vertex \((h, k)\) from \(a(x - h)^2 + k\).

pool.text: Pearson Edexcel 4MA1 Structured Paper Question [Paper 2 (Calculator), 8 marks]: Consider \( s(t) = t^2 - 76t + 1395 \) defined for \( t \in \mathbb{R} \).
hints: Multi-Part Strategy (Functions, Transformations & Arithmetic Series): work sequentially from the opening part because intermediate results feed directly into the subsequent parts.
Translate the condition on \(s(t) = t^2 - 76t + 1395\) into an explicit algebraic equation showing every method step clearly.
Substitute your intermediate expression into the final part and verify domain and sign conditions to secure full accuracy marks.

parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.prompt: Write \( s(t) \) in completed-square form \( (t - h)^2 + d \); enter the value of \( h \).

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.prompt: Hence state the minimum value \( d \) of \( s(t) \).

parts.label: (b)
parts.prompt: Solve \( s(t) = 0 \) and enter the larger root.

parts.label: (c)
parts.prompt: Determine the instantaneous rate of change \( s'(45) \) at \( t = 45 \).

pool.text: Pearson Edexcel 4MA1 Structured Paper Question [Paper 2 (Calculator), 8 marks]: Consider \( s(t) = t^2 - 90t + 2009 \) defined for \( t \in \mathbb{R} \).

Translate the condition on \(s(t) = t^2 - 90t + 2009\) into an explicit algebraic equation showing every method step clearly.
Substitute your intermediate expression into the final part and verify domain and sign conditions to secure full accuracy marks.

parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.prompt: Write \( s(t) \) in completed-square form \( (t - h)^2 + d \); enter the value of \( h \).

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.prompt: Hence state the minimum value \( d \) of \( s(t) \).

parts.label: (b)
parts.prompt: Solve \( s(t) = 0 \) and enter the larger root.

parts.label: (c)
parts.prompt: Determine the instantaneous rate of change \( s'(49) \) at \( t = 49 \).

pool.text: Find the equation of the perpendicular bisector of the line segment joining \(A(2, 4)\) and \(B(6, 12)\) (Segment #2).
pool.sol: Midpoint \(M = (4, 8)\) and gradient \(m_{AB} = \frac{8}{4} = 2\). The perpendicular gradient is \(m_\perp = -\frac{1}{2}\), giving \(y - 8 = -\frac{1}{2}(x - 4)\), which simplifies to \(y = -\frac{1}{2}x + 10\).
hints: Calculate the midpoint \(M\) of \(A(2, 4)\) and \(B(6, 12)\).

Substitute \(M\) and \(m_\perp\) into \(y - y_M = m_\perp(x - x_M)\) and rearrange into \(y = mx + c\) form.

pool.sol_ar: نقطة المنتصف \(M = (13, 13)\) و الميل \(m_{AB} = \frac{6}{2} = 3\). العمودي الميل يساوي \(m_\perp = -\frac{1}{3}\)، مما يعطي \(y - 13 = -\frac{1}{3}(x - 13)\)، التي يتبسّط إلى \(y = -\frac{1}{3}x + \frac{52}{3}\).
hints_ar: احسب نقطة المنتصف \(M\) من \(A(12, 10)\) و \(B(14, 16)\).
أوجد الميل \(m_{AB}\) و خذ له سالب مقلوب \(m_\perp = -1 / m_{AB}\).
عوّض \(M\) و \(m_\perp\) إلى \(y - y_M = m_\perp(x - x_M)\) و أعد ترتيب إلى \(y = mx + c\) الصيغة.

Substitute your intermediate expression into the final part and verify domain and sign conditions to secure full accuracy marks.

parts.label: (b)

pool.text: Find the equation of the perpendicular bisector of the line segment joining \(A(2, 2)\) and \(B(8, 4)\) (Segment #79).
pool.sol: Midpoint \(M = (5, 3)\) and gradient \(m_{AB} = \frac{2}{6} = \frac{1}{3}\). The perpendicular gradient is \(m_\perp = -3\), giving \(y - 3 = -3(x - 5)\), which simplifies to \(y = -3x + 18\).
hints: Calculate the midpoint \(M\) of \(A(2, 2)\) and \(B(8, 4)\).
Find the gradient \(m_{AB}\) and take its negative reciprocal \(m_\perp = -1 / m_{AB}\).
Substitute \(M\) and \(m_\perp\) into \(y - y_M = m_\perp(x - x_M)\) and rearrange into \(y = mx + c\) form.

pool.text: Chords \(AB\) and \(CD\) intersect internally at point \(P\) inside a circle. Given \(PA = 3\text{ cm}\), \(PB = 8\text{ cm}\), and \(PC = 4\text{ cm}\), find the length \(PD\).
pool.sol: By the Intersecting Chords Theorem, \(PA \cdot PB = PC \cdot PD \implies 3 \times 8 = 4 \cdot PD \implies PD = 6\text{ cm}\).
hints: Apply the Intersecting Chords Theorem: \(PA \times PB = PC \times PD\).
Compute the product \(PA \times PB = 24\).
Divide that product by \(PC = 4\) to find \(PD\).

hints: Apply the Intersecting Chords Theorem: \(PA \times PB = PC \times PD\).
Compute the product \(PA \times PB = 20\).
Divide that product by \(PC = 2\) to find \(PD\).
pool.educational_aim: Circle Theorems, Polygons & Geometric Similarity: apply applying circle equations, arc-sector geometry, and tangent-chord theorems across multi-step problems.
pool.text_ar: أوتار \(AB\) و \(CD\) يتقاطع داخليًا عند نقطة \(P\) داخل دائرة. المعطى \(PA = 5\text{ cm}\)، \(PB = 4\text{ cm}\)، و \(PC = 2\text{ cm}\)، أوجد الطول \(PD\).
pool.sol_ar: بواسطة متقاطع أوتار نظرية، \(PA \cdot PB = PC \cdot PD \implies 5 \times 4 = 2 \cdot PD \implies PD = 10\text{ cm}\).
hints_ar: طبّق متقاطع أوتار نظرية: \(PA \times PB = PC \times PD\).
احسب حاصل الضرب \(PA \times PB = 20\).
اقسم أن حاصل الضرب بواسطة \(PC = 2\) إلى أوجد \(PD\).

pool.text: Two mathematically similar solids \(S_1\) and \(S_2\) have corresponding heights in the ratio \(3 : 5\). Given that the volume of \(S_1\) is \(54\text{ cm}^3\), calculate the volume of \(S_2\).
pool.sol: Volume scales as the cube of the linear ratio: \(\frac{V_2}{V_1} = \left(\frac{5}{3}\right)^3 = \frac{125}{27}\), so \(V_2 = 250\text{ cm}^3\).
hints: Identify the linear scale factor \(k = \frac{5}{3}\).
For similar 3D solids, volume scales by \(k^3\) (not \(k\) or \(k^2\)).
Multiply \(54\) by \(\left(\frac{5}{3}\right)^3\).

pool.text: Find the coordinates of the local minimum stationary point on the curve \(y = 2x^3 - 24x + 3\) for \(x > 0\) (Curve #2).
pool.sol: Differentiating gives \(\frac{dy}{dx} = 6x^2 - 24 = 0 \implies x^2 = 4\). For \(x > 0\), \(x = 2\) with \(\frac{d^2y}{dx^2} = 24 > 0\), and \(y(2) = -29\).
hints: Differentiate \(y\) with respect to \(x\) using the power rule.
Set \(\frac{dy}{dx} = 0\) and select the positive stationary value \(x > 0\).
Substitute \(x\) back into the original cubic equation to find the \(y\)-coordinate.

pool.text: Find the coordinates of the local minimum stationary point on the curve \(y = 3x^3 - 81x + 4\) for \(x > 0\) (Curve #3).
pool.sol: Differentiating gives \(\frac{dy}{dx} = 9x^2 - 81 = 0 \implies x^2 = 9\). For \(x > 0\), \(x = 3\) with \(\frac{d^2y}{dx^2} = 54 > 0\), and \(y(3) = -158\).
hints: Differentiate \(y\) with respect to \(x\) using the power rule.

Substitute \(x\) back into the original cubic equation to find the \(y\)-coordinate.

pool.text: Find the coordinates of the local minimum stationary point on the curve \(y = 3x^3 - 225x + 9\) for \(x > 0\) (Curve #23).
pool.sol: Differentiating gives \(\frac{dy}{dx} = 9x^2 - 225 = 0 \implies x^2 = 25\). For \(x > 0\), \(x = 5\) with \(\frac{d^2y}{dx^2} = 90 > 0\), and \(y(5) = -741\).
hints: Differentiate \(y\) with respect to \(x\) using the power rule.

Substitute \(x\) back into the original cubic equation to find the \(y\)-coordinate.

hints_ar: اشتق \(y\) بالنسبة إلى \(x\) باستخدام قاعدة القوة.
مجموعة \(\frac{dy}{dx} = 0\) و اختر موجب ساكن قيمة \(x > 0\).
عوّض \(x\) مرة أخرى إلى الأصلية تكعيبي معادلة إلى أوجد إحداثي \(y\).

pool.text: Find the coordinates of the local minimum stationary point on the curve \(y = 3x^3 - 9x + 14\) for \(x > 0\) (Curve #43).
pool.sol: Differentiating gives \(\frac{dy}{dx} = 9x^2 - 9 = 0 \implies x^2 = 1\). For \(x > 0\), \(x = 1\) with \(\frac{d^2y}{dx^2} = 18 > 0\), and \(y(1) = 8\).
hints: Differentiate \(y\) with respect to \(x\) using the power rule.
Set \(\frac{dy}{dx} = 0\) and select the positive stationary value \(x > 0\).
Substitute \(x\) back into the original cubic equation to find the \(y\)-coordinate.

Substitute \(x\) back into the original cubic equation to find the \(y\)-coordinate.

حدّد فصل العرض من \(10 < t \le 25\).
اقسم فصل التكرار \(22.5\) بواسطة أن فصل العرض.
